name: New Era Supply Co
old_description: We pride ourselves on providing our local businesses and event coordinators with some of the highest quality garments and printing available. Reasonable prices and straightforward business representaition have made New Era Supply Company the "go to" for the needs of many in the River Region as well as nationwide.  We also offer brand consultation including creative direction and manufacturing. If you have any questions regarding pricing/turnaround/artwork feel free to call or email and we will be happy to assist.
about:
Based in Millbrook, Alabama, at 5055 B Main Street, New Era Supply Co provides garments and printing services to businesses and event coordinators across the River Region and nationwide. The company is operated by contacts Brandon and Jonathan, who handle customer inquiries and orders.

The company’s primary offering is decorated apparel, including screen printing and other garment printing methods, complemented by brand consultation services that encompass creative direction and manufacturing coordination. They also provide a printables catalog for customers to select products, and assist with pricing, turnaround estimates, and artwork preparation.

Its customer base includes local businesses, event coordinators, and organizations throughout the River Region, with a reach extending nationwide. The company positions itself as a go-to resource for custom apparel and branding needs in its regional market.

New Era Supply Co differentiates itself through reasonable prices, straightforward business representation, and a consultative model that blends creative direction with production capabilities, aiming to simplify the process for clients seeking custom garments and brand development.
